scripts.title: Aimbot script
scripts.script:
-- โหลดบริการและตัวแปรหลัก
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = workspace.CurrentCamera

-- สร้าง ScreenGui
local ScreenGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
ScreenGui.Name = "AdvancedAimbotGui_Rainbow"
ScreenGui.Parent = game.CoreGui

-- ตัวแปรตั้งค่าระบบ
getgenv().AimbotEnabled = false
getgenv().AimbotMode = "Closest" -- "Closest" หรือ "FOV"
getgenv().FOVShow = false
getgenv().FOVRadius = 120 -- ขนาดรัศมีเริ่มต้น

-- สร้างวงกลม FOV (Drawing API)
local FOVCircle = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVCircle.Visible = false
FOVCircle.Radius = getgenv().FOVRadius
FOVCircle.Thickness = 2
FOVCircle.Transparency = 0.8
FOVCircle.Filled = false

-- ฟังก์ชันคำนวณสีรุ้งตามเวลา (Rainbow Color)
local function GetRainbowColor()
    local tickTime = tick() * 5
    local r = math.sin(tickTime) * 127 + 128
    local g = math.sin(tickTime + 2) * 127 + 128
    local b = math.sin(tickTime + 4) * 127 + 128
    return Color3.fromRGB(r, g, b)
end

-- อัปเดตตำแหน่งและสีวงกลมทุกเฟรม
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    FOVCircle.Position = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)
    FOVCircle.Radius = getgenv().FOVRadius
    if getgenv().FOVShow then
        FOVCircle.Visible = true
        FOVCircle.Color = GetRainbowColor()
    else
        FOVCircle.Visible = false
    end
end)

-- สร้างกรอบหลัก (Frame)
local MainFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
MainFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, 200, 0, 210)
MainFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0.05, 0, 0.2, 0)
MainFrame.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35)
MainFrame.BorderSizePixel = 0
MainFrame.Active = true
MainFrame.Draggable = true
MainFrame.Parent = ScreenGui

-- ข้อความหัวข้อ [New]
local Title = Instance.new("TextLabel")
Title.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 30)
Title.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20)
Title.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
Title.Text = "Aimbot [New]"
Title.TextSize = 14
Title.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
Title.Parent = MainFrame

-- ปุ่มเปิด-ปิด Aimbot
local ToggleBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ToggleBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 28)
ToggleBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.17, 0)
ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
ToggleBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ToggleBtn.Text = "Aimbot: OFF"
ToggleBtn.TextSize = 13
ToggleBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ToggleBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- ปุ่มสลับโหมด
local ModeBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
ModeBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 28)
ModeBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.33, 0)
ModeBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 100, 200)
ModeBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
ModeBtn.Text = "Mode: Closest"
ModeBtn.TextSize = 13
ModeBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
ModeBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- ปุ่มเปิด-ปิดวงกลม FOV
local FOVBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
FOVBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 28)
FOVBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.49, 0)
FOVBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
FOVBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
FOVBtn.Text = "FOV Circle: OFF"
FOVBtn.TextSize = 13
FOVBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
FOVBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- ปุ่มเพิ่มขนาด FOV (+)
local PlusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
PlusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 28)
PlusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.68, 0)
PlusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
PlusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
PlusBtn.Text = "FOV +"
PlusBtn.TextSize = 12
PlusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
PlusBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- ปุ่มลดขนาด FOV (-)
local MinusBtn = Instance.new("TextButton")
MinusBtn.Size = UDim2.new(0.4, 0, 0, 28)
MinusBtn.Position = UDim2.new(0.525, 0, 0.68, 0)
MinusBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 70)
MinusBtn.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
MinusBtn.Text = "FOV -"
MinusBtn.TextSize = 12
MinusBtn.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSansBold
MinusBtn.Parent = MainFrame

-- แสดงค่าขนาด FOV ปัจจุบัน
local FOVLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
FOVLabel.Size = UDim2.new(0.85, 0, 0, 20)
FOVLabel.Position = UDim2.new(0.075, 0, 0.84, 0)
FOVLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
FOVLabel.Text = "FOV Size: 120"
FOVLabel.TextSize = 12
FOVLabel.Font = Enum.Font.SourceSans
FOVLabel.Parent = MainFrame

-- ควบคุมปุ่มเปิด/ปิด Aimbot
ToggleBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().AimbotEnabled = not getgenv().AimbotEnabled
    if getgenv().AimbotEnabled then
        ToggleBtn.Text = "Aimbot: ON"
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 200, 50)
    else
        ToggleBtn.Text = "Aimbot: OFF"
        ToggleBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 50, 50)
    end
end)

-- ควบคุมปุ่มสลับโหมด
ModeBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    if getgenv().AimbotMode == "Closest" then
        getgenv().AimbotMode = "FOV"
        ModeBtn.Text = "Mode: FOV Target"
    else
        getgenv().AimbotMode = "Closest"
        ModeBtn.Text = "Mode: Closest"
    end
end)

-- ควบคุมปุ่มเปิด/ปิดวงกลม FOV
FOVBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().FOVShow = not getgenv().FOVShow
    if getgenv().FOVShow then
        FOVBtn.Text = "FOV Circle: ON"
        FOVBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(50, 150, 200)
    else
        FOVBtn.Text = "FOV Circle: OFF"
        FOVBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(100, 100, 100)
    end
end)

-- ปรับเพิ่มขนาดวงกลม
PlusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().FOVRadius = math.min(getgenv().FOVRadius + 20, 400)
    FOVLabel.Text = "FOV Size: " .. tostring(getgenv().FOVRadius)
end)

-- ปรับลดขนาดวงกลม
MinusBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
    getgenv().FOVRadius = math.max(getgenv().FOVRadius - 20, 20)
    FOVLabel.Text = "FOV Size: " .. tostring(getgenv().FOVRadius)
end)

-- ฟังก์ชันค้นหาเป้าหมาย
local function GetTarget()
    local target = nil
    local shortestDist = math.huge
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2)

    for _, player in pairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer and player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") then
            local humanoid = player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local pos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(player.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position)
                if onScreen then
                    local screenPos = Vector2.new(pos.X, pos.Y)
                    local dist = (screenPos - screenCenter).Magnitude

                    if getgenv().AimbotMode == "Closest" then
                        if dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    elseif getgenv().AimbotMode == "FOV" then
                        if dist <= getgenv().FOVRadius and dist < shortestDist then
                            shortestDist = dist
                            target = player.Character.HumanoidRootPart
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    return target
end

-- ลูปการทำงานล็อกเป้า
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    if getgenv().AimbotEnabled then
        local targetPart = GetTarget()
        if targetPart then
            Camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
        end
    end
end)

scripts.script:
-- // Delta Executor - Drone com Comando Estilo DJI RC (v3 com Térmico e Bombas)
-- Só toque (telemóvel): joystick esquerdo = altura/girar | joystick direito = mover

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

-- Se executares o script outra vez, limpa a versão anterior
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G
if env.__DroneCleanup then pcall(env.__DroneCleanup) end

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local character = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
local rootPart = character:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
local camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

if Workspace:FindFirstChild("RealisticDroneModel") then Workspace.RealisticDroneModel:Destroy() end
if player.PlayerGui:FindFirstChild("DJIRCControlGui") then player.PlayerGui.DJIRCControlGui:Destroy() end

-- Configuração
local SPEED, VSPEED, YAW_SPEED = 40, 25, 2.2
local DEFAULT_FOV = 70

-- Estado
local conns = {}
local flying, mode = false, "manual" -- manual | takeoff | rth | follow | land
local battery = 100
local yaw = 0
local curVel = Vector3.zero
local curTiltF, curTiltS = 0, 0
local rotorSpeed, rotorAngle = 0, 0
local cameraAttached, recording, recTime = false, false, 0
local fov = DEFAULT_FOV
local stickL, stickR = Vector2.zero, Vector2.zero
local rotors = {}

-- Efeitos extra
local thermalOn = false
local colorCorrection = Instance.new("ColorCorrectionEffect")

local function getHumanoid()
    return character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
end

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 1. Modelo do drone
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local droneModel = Instance.new("Model")
droneModel.Name = "RealisticDroneModel"
droneModel.Parent = Workspace

local dronePart = Instance.new("Part")
dronePart.Name = "DroneCore"
dronePart.Size = Vector3.new(2, 0.6, 2.5)
dronePart.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
dronePart.Color = Color3.fromRGB(55, 60, 65)
dronePart.CanCollide = false
dronePart.Parent = droneModel
droneModel.PrimaryPart = dronePart

-- Raycast para descobrir o chão
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {droneModel, character}

local function groundY(pos)
    local r = Workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0), Vector3.new(0, -1000, 0), rayParams)
    return r and r.Position.Y or nil
end

-- Posição inicial: no chão, à frente do jogador
local look = rootPart.CFrame.LookVector
local startPos = rootPart.Position + look * 4
local startGround = groundY(startPos + Vector3.new(0, 5, 0))
yaw = math.atan2(-look.X, -look.Z)
dronePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(startPos.X, (startGround or (rootPart.Position.Y - 2.5)) + 0.9, startPos.Z)
    * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)

local function weldTo(p0, p1)
    local w = Instance.new("Weld")
    w.Part0 = p0
    w.Part1 = p1
    w.C0 = p0.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p1.CFrame)
    w.Parent = p0
    return w
end

local function addPart(size, offset, color, material, shape)
    local p = Instance.new("Part")
    p.Size = size
    p.CFrame = dronePart.CFrame * offset
    p.Color = color
    p.Material = material or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    if shape then p.Shape = shape end
    p.CanCollide = false
    p.Massless = true
    p.Parent = droneModel
    return p, weldTo(dronePart, p)
end

-- Câmara gimbal e sensores
addPart(Vector3.new(0.6, 0.5, 0.6), CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.2), Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 20), Enum.Material.Metal)
addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.4, 0.3), CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -1.45), Color3.fromRGB(0, 170, 255), Enum.Material.Glass)
addPart(Vector3.new(1.2, 0.3, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 0.1, -1.25), Color3.fromRGB(35, 35, 35))

-- Luz do drone
local lightColors = {
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60),
    Color3.fromRGB(180, 80, 255),
    Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
}
local lightIdx = 1
local lightOn = true
local lightPart = addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.1, 0.4), CFrame.new(0, 0.35, 1.3), lightColors[1], Enum.Material.Neon)
local light = Instance.new("PointLight")
light.Color = lightColors[1]
light.Range = 15
light.Brightness = 4
light.Parent = lightPart

-- Braços, motores e hélices
for _, sx in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
    for _, sz in ipairs({-1, 1}) do
        local corner = Vector3.new(sx * 1.7, 0, sz * 1.7)
        addPart(Vector3.new(0.3, 0.15, corner.Magnitude), CFrame.lookAt(corner / 2, corner),
            Color3.fromRGB(70, 75, 80))
        addPart(Vector3.new(0.4, 0.6, 0.6),
            CFrame.new(corner + Vector3.new(0, 0.2, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90)),
            Color3.fromRGB(30, 30, 30), Enum.Material.Metal, Enum.PartType.Cylinder)
        local blade, bw = addPart(Vector3.new(2.2, 0.05, 0.25),
            CFrame.new(corner + Vector3.new(0, 0.45, 0)) * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(45), 0),
            Color3.fromRGB(240, 130, 0), Enum.Material.Neon)
        table.insert(rotors, {weld = bw, base = bw.C0, dir = (sx * sz > 0) and 1 or -1})
    end
end

local bv = Instance.new("BodyVelocity")
bv.MaxForce = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
bv.Velocity = Vector3.zero
bv.Parent = dronePart

local bg = Instance.new("BodyGyro")
bg.MaxTorque = Vector3.new(math.huge, math.huge, math.huge)
bg.CFrame = dronePart.CFrame
bg.Parent = dronePart

---------------------------------------------------------------------
-- 2. Interface (Comando com mais espaço para os novos botões)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
local function make(class, props, parent)
    local o = Instance.new(class)
    for k, v in pairs(props) do o[k] = v end
    o.Parent = parent
    return o
end

local function roundify(o, r)
    make("UICorner", {CornerRadius = UDim.new(0, r)}, o)
end

local screenGui = make("ScreenGui", {
    Name = "DJIRCControlGui",
    ResetOnSpawn = false,
    IgnoreGuiInset = true,
}, player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui"))

-- Corpo do comando (ligeiramente mais alto para caber tudo)
local rcFrame = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 300, 0, 244),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 50),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(45, 48, 55),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, screenGui)
roundify(rcFrame, 14)

local topBar = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 28),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(35, 38, 44),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, rcFrame)
roundify(topBar, 14)

local ledStatus = make("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -34, 1, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "🔋 100%  [ DJI RC - LINKED ]",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120),
    TextSize = 11,
    Font = Enum.Font.Code,
}, topBar)

local btnClose = make("TextButton", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 24, 0, 24),
    Position = UDim2.new(1, -28, 0, 2),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(120, 30, 30),
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    Text = "X",
    TextSize = 10,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
}, topBar)
roundify(btnClose, 4)

-- Ecrã do comando (telemetria)
local screenDisplay = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -20, 0, 66),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 10, 0, 34),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(15, 15, 20),
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
}, rcFrame)
roundify(screenDisplay, 8)

local screenLabel = make("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "🏔️ DRONE 4K\n[ Pronto para descolar ]",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 220, 255),
    TextSize = 12,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
}, screenDisplay)

-- Botões Grid
local btnContainer = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, -16, 0, 132),
    Position = UDim2.new(0, 8, 0, 106),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
}, rcFrame)
make("UIGridLayout", {
    CellSize = UDim2.new(0, 66, 0, 28),
    CellPadding = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, 4),
    SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder,
}, btnContainer)

local btns, btnColors = {}, {}
local GRAY = Color3.fromRGB(80, 85, 95)

local function createRcBtn(name, text, off, on, order)
    local b = make("TextButton", {
        BackgroundColor3 = off,
        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        Text = text,
        TextSize = 10,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
        LayoutOrder = order,
    }, btnContainer)
    roundify(b, 6)
    btns[name] = b
    btnColors[b] = {off = off, on = on or off}
    return b
end

local function setBtn(b, isOn)
    b.BackgroundColor3 = isOn and btnColors[b].on or btnColors[b].off
end

createRcBtn("fly", "🚀 Voar", Color3.fromRGB(0, 110, 200), Color3.fromRGB(0, 180, 90), 1)
createRcBtn("cam", "👁️ Câmara", Color3.fromRGB(40, 140, 70), Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 0), 2)
createRcBtn("rth", "🏠 Casa", Color3.fromRGB(0, 120, 130), Color3.fromRGB(0, 200, 210), 3)
createRcBtn("follow", "🎯 Seguir", Color3.fromRGB(110, 60, 170), Color3.fromRGB(170, 90, 240), 4)
createRcBtn("zin", "➕ Zoom", GRAY, nil, 5)
createRcBtn("zout", "➖ Zoom", GRAY, nil, 6)
createRcBtn("photo", "📸 Foto", GRAY, nil, 7)
createRcBtn("rec", "🔴 REC", Color3.fromRGB(120, 40, 40), Color3.fromRGB(220, 30, 30), 8)
createRcBtn("light", "💡 Luz", Color3.fromRGB(150, 120, 0), Color3.fromRGB(230, 190, 0), 9)
createRcBtn("color", "🎨 Cor", GRAY, nil, 10)
createRcBtn("thermal", "🌡️ Térmico", Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 80), Color3.fromRGB(255, 100, 0), 11)
createRcBtn("drop", "📦 Largar", Color3.fromRGB(130, 70, 0), Color3.fromRGB(200, 110, 0), 12)
createRcBtn("pull", "📍 Puxar", Color3.fromRGB(180, 110, 0), nil, 13)
createRcBtn("boom", "💥 Explodir", Color3.fromRGB(180, 40, 40), nil, 14)
setBtn(btns.light, true)

-- HUD de visão em primeira pessoa
local hudGui = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Visible = false,
}, screenGui)

make("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40),
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    Text = "+",
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100),
    TextSize = 35,
    Font = Enum.Font.Code,
}, hudGui)

local hudRec = make("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 28),
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0, 50),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100),
    Text = "[ ⏺ STANDBY ]",
    TextSize = 12,
    Font = Enum.Font.Code,
}, hudGui)
roundify(hudRec, 6)

local hudTelemetry = make("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 260, 0, 40),
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 1),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 1, -12),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.4,
    TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 100),
    Text = "",
    TextSize = 11,
    Font = Enum.Font.Code,
}, hudGui)
roundify(hudTelemetry, 6)

-- Flash de foto e aviso
local flash = make("Frame", {
    Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 1, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    BackgroundTransparency = 1,
    BorderSizePixel = 0,
    ZIndex = 10,
}, screenGui)

local toastLabel = make("TextLabel", {
    Size = UDim2.new(0, 220, 0, 30),
    AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
    Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.7, 0),
    BackgroundColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0),
    BackgroundTransparency = 0.3,
    TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
    Text = "",
    TextSize = 13,
    Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    Visible = false,
    ZIndex = 11,
}, screenGui)
roundify(toastLabel, 8)

local toastId = 0
local function toast(msg)
    toastId += 1
    local id = toastId
    toastLabel.Text = msg
    toastLabel.Visible = true
    task.delay(1.8, function()
        if id == toastId and toastLabel.Parent then toastLabel.Visible = false end
    end)
end

-- Joysticks táteis
local function makeStick(pos, caption, callback)
    local base = make("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 100, 0, 100),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = pos,
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(20, 20, 25),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.5,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
        Active = true,
    }, screenGui)
    roundify(base, 50)
    make("TextLabel", {
        Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 14),
        Position = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, -16),
        BackgroundTransparency = 1,
        Text = caption,
        TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1),
        TextSize = 10,
        Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
    }, base)
    local knob = make("Frame", {
        Size = UDim2.new(0, 40, 0, 40),
        AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5),
        Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0),
        BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(230, 230, 235),
        BackgroundTransparency = 0.2,
        BorderSizePixel = 0,
    }, base)
    roundify(knob, 20)

    local active
    local function update(p)
        local center = base.AbsolutePosition + base.AbsoluteSize / 2
        local maxR = base.AbsoluteSize.X / 2 - 8
        local delta = Vector2.new(p.X, p.Y) - center
        if delta.Magnitude > maxR then delta = delta.Unit * maxR end
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, delta.X, 0.5, delta.Y)
        callback(Vector2.new(delta.X / maxR, -delta.Y / maxR))
    end
    local function reset()
        active = nil
        knob.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, 0, 0.5, 0)
        callback(Vector2.zero)
    end

    base.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
        if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
            or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 then
            active = input
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end)
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
        if not active then return end
        if input == active
            or (active.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1
                and input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement) then
            update(input.Position)
        end
    end))
    table.insert(conns, UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
        if input == active then reset() end
    end))
end

local function cleanup()

        camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom

local function homePos()

local function followPos()

local function faceDir(v, dt)
    if v.Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
    local target = math.atan2(-v.X, -v.Z)
    local diff = (target - yaw + math.pi) % (2 * math.pi) - math.pi
    yaw = yaw + diff * math.min(1, dt * 4)
end

local function getInput()
    return stickL.X, stickL.Y, stickR.X, stickR.Y
end

local modeNames = {
    manual = "MANUAL", takeoff = "A DESCOLAR", rth = "REGRESSAR A CASA",
    follow = "A SEGUIR-TE", land = "A ATERRAR",
}
local uiTimer = 0

-- Ciclo principal
table.insert(conns, RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
    if not dronePart.Parent then cleanup() return end

    local pos = dronePart.Position
    local gy = groundY(pos)
    local minY = gy and (gy + 0.9) or -math.huge
    local yawIn, vertIn, strafeIn, fwdIn = getInput()
    local inputMag = math.abs(yawIn) + math.abs(vertIn) + math.abs(strafeIn) + math.abs(fwdIn)

    local vel = Vector3.zero
    local tiltF, tiltS = 0, 0

    if flying then
        battery = math.max(0, battery - dt * (0.5 + curVel.Magnitude / 80))
        if battery <= 0 and mode ~= "land" then
            setMode("land")
            toast("🔋 Bateria vazia, a aterrar")
        end
        if inputMag > 0.2 and battery > 0 and (mode == "rth" or mode == "follow" or mode == "land") then
            setMode("manual")
        end

        if mode == "takeoff" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, 8, 0)
            if pos.Y - (gy or (pos.Y - 3)) >= 3 then setMode("manual") end
        elseif mode == "manual" then
            yaw = yaw - yawIn * dt * YAW_SPEED
            local horiz = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0):VectorToWorldSpace(
                Vector3.new(strafeIn * SPEED, 0, -fwdIn * SPEED))
            vel = horiz + Vector3.new(0, vertIn * VSPEED, 0)
            tiltF, tiltS = fwdIn, strafeIn
        elseif mode == "rth" then
            local d = homePos() - pos
            local flat = Vector3.new(d.X, 0, d.Z)
            if flat.Magnitude > 3 then
                vel = flat.Unit * math.min(SPEED, flat.Magnitude * 3)
                    + Vector3.new(0, math.clamp(d.Y * 2, -VSPEED, VSPEED), 0)
                faceDir(flat, dt)
                tiltF = 0.6
            else
                setMode("land")
            end
        elseif mode == "follow" then
            local d = followPos() - pos
            vel = d * 3
            if vel.Magnitude > SPEED * 1.1 then vel = vel.Unit * SPEED * 1.1 end
            local toPlayer = rootPart.Position - pos
            faceDir(Vector3.new(toPlayer.X, 0, toPlayer.Z), dt)
        elseif mode == "land" then
            vel = Vector3.new(0, -8, 0)
            if gy and pos.Y <= minY + 0.15 then
                flying = false
                setMode("manual")
                refreshFlyBtn()
                toast("🛬 Aterrou")
            end
        end

        if pos.Y <= minY and vel.Y < 0 then
            vel = Vector3.new(vel.X, 0, vel.Z)
        end
    else
        battery = math.min(100, battery + dt * 3)
    end

    curVel = curVel:Lerp(vel, math.min(1, dt * 5))
    curTiltF = curTiltF + (tiltF - curTiltF) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
    curTiltS = curTiltS + (tiltS - curTiltS) * math.min(1, dt * 6)
    bv.Velocity = curVel
    bg.CFrame = CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(-curTiltF * 0.3, 0, -curTiltS * 0.3)

    local targetRotor = flying and (45 + curVel.Magnitude * 0.5) or 0
    rotorSpeed = rotorSpeed + (targetRotor - rotorSpeed) * math.min(1, dt * 3)
    rotorAngle = rotorAngle + rotorSpeed * dt
    for _, r in ipairs(rotors) do
        r.weld.C0 = r.base * CFrame.Angles(0, rotorAngle * r.dir, 0)
    end

    if cameraAttached then
        local gp = dronePart.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(Vector3.new(0, -0.2, -1.7))
        camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(gp) * CFrame.Angles(0, yaw, 0)
        camera.FieldOfView = fov
    end

    if recording then recTime += dt end

    uiTimer += dt
    if uiTimer >= 0.1 then
        uiTimer = 0
        local alt = gy and (pos.Y - gy) or pos.Y
        local dist = (pos - rootPart.Position).Magnitude
        local zoomX = DEFAULT_FOV / fov
        local bat = math.floor(battery)
        local telemetry = string.format("ALT %dm  VEL %d  DIST %dm\n🔋 %d%%  🔍 x%.1f",
            math.floor(alt), math.floor(curVel.Magnitude), math.floor(dist), bat, zoomX)

        local state = flying and modeNames[mode] or (battery < 100 and "A CARREGAR" or "NO CHÃO")
        screenLabel.Text = "📡 " .. state .. "\n" .. telemetry
        hudTelemetry.Text = telemetry

        local bc = battery > 50 and Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 120)
            or battery > 20 and Color3.fromRGB(255, 200, 0)
            or Color3.fromRGB(255, 60, 60)
        ledStatus.TextColor3 = bc
        ledStatus.Text = string.format("🔋 %d%%  [ DJI RC - LINKED ]", bat)

        if recording then
            local blink = math.floor(recTime * 2) % 2 == 0
            hudRec.Text = string.format("[ %s REC %02d:%02d ]", blink and "🔴" or "⚫",
                math.floor(recTime / 60), math.floor(recTime % 60))
        else
            hudRec.Text = "[ ⏺ STANDBY ]"
        end
    end
end))
